hypothesis: A private captured K producer avoids direct eager K launch overhead while retaining overlap with native main Prolog.
schedule: aux waits main input-ready, copies raw hidden and independent Indexer cos/sin into owned same-dtype buffers, replays native K-only graph. Main runs original Prolog, waits aux, executes original cache writes.
ownership: Private graph/pool/input/output per fixed N and precision case. Auxiliary replay cannot overwrite outputs until prior main consumers complete because each invocation waits current main stream before reusing static inputs/outputs. No main-query graph or cache-write relocation.
cases: Same N6/N24 and original BF16/C8 branches;3 changing input generations; ABBAx3 40 complete eager outer calls/block; preserve all device/host timings.
gate: All main Q/querynorm and KV, Indexer K/scale/weights/cache bitwise vs current native, then complete outer-fragment timings. No service gain or full-model quality claim.
SDMA: New input copies must be physically verified before full-service acceptance, including actual deployed scope; no transport fallback.
